functions.description: Draw grotto map markers for discovered cells
functions.notes: Only remaining cause: the target keeps cell = grotto+0x1dc in its own register (sl) with grotto dead across the 16x16 loop, so lo=row*2 lands in r2. In ours the compiler propagates cell into grotto+offset, keeping grotto live in r2, which shifts lo/col to sb/sl and costs one instruction. cell2 = cell+1 already stays a stack variable as in the target. Ruled out: &cells[0] or &cells[1] taken from grotto (both propagate), cells taken from zone directly (0x25c8 constant split, 411-421 bytes), no grotto variable, GrottoView reference, reordered declarations, grotto fields read inside the loop, no lo variable, bits as [16][2], call args inline or locals ordered y-first (identical output). colorsweep's best was short lo (230 bytes, LOOP-SHAPE), a type hack that was not adopted. 23 gate runs.
